lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review week 1 by handling a small scheduling conflict with questions, negation, and V2 word order.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Coordinating a shared errand when one person is delayed and another has a fixed appointment.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik need to coordinate an errand, a delay, and an appointment so both plans still work.

main_focus.name: mixed review of V2, questions, and main-clause negation
main_focus.description: Combine the week 1 sentence patterns in a realistic scheduling exchange.
model_examples: I dag kan jag inte vänta länge.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use each reviewed pattern at least twice where it fits naturally.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic reason phrases with för att

useful_chunks: I dag kan jag inte vänta länge.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Recycle week 1 scheduling language while keeping the scenario concrete.

dialogue_shape.opening: A timing conflict is introduced clearly.
dialogue_shape.middle: They ask for details, explain one limitation, and reorganize the order of actions.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a plan that solves the conflict.

target_complexity.repetition: review patterns should recur without sounding like drills

focus: the timing conflict in the situation
the sequence of actions in the final plan

sentence_focus: one sentence with fronted i dag and kan inte
one question asking when something must happen
one sentence with först and behöver
one sentence suggesting a changed time
one sentence explaining that both people have enough time
